title: Gary E. Stevenson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary to the Japan Fukuoka Mission.
Married Lesa Jean Higley; 1979; Idaho Falls Idaho Temple; four sons:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from Utah State University.
Employment: Chief Operating Officer of Icon Health & Fitness, Inc.
Counselor in Bishopric; Counselor in Stake Presidency; Bishop.
President of the Japan Nagoya Mission, 2004-2007
